questions.stem: During boiling, the internal energy of a substance increases because:

options.text: The kinetic energy of particles increases, raising the temperature
The substance absorbs heat and converts it all to kinetic energy
The potential energy increases as bonds between particles are broken, while kinetic energy stays the same
Both kinetic and potential energy decrease

questions.explanation: During boiling (a change of state), the energy supplied goes into breaking bonds between particles, increasing their potential energy. The kinetic energy (and therefore the temperature) stays constant until the change of state is complete.
